caption: A sack of potatoes is tipped out onto a barn floor, and the potatoes tumble out and roll apart into a loose spread.

sa.check: A sack of potatoes is tipped out onto a barn floor.
They roll apart into a loose spread.
The tip comes first and the spread follows.

pc.expect: They fall and roll away from the pile and come to rest scattered.
pc.fail: They roll back in; or move as a block; or roll uphill.

pc.expect: The potatoes are firm and roll and bump, not stacking or holding the sack's shape.
pc.fail: They hold the sack's shape; or stack; or squash.
They float; or rise; or hang.

pc.expect: They come to rest and stay.
pc.fail: They restart; or speed up; or jump.
Potatoes multiply; or vanish; or turn into other objects.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sack and the barn stay the same.
pc.fail: The sack changes colour; or the barn rearranges; or the potatoes change colour.
